title: Smith dataset sample line (samples.jsonl, format smith.evals.sample/1, frozen in slice 1a)
description: One sample per line. A null top-level field is the same as an absent one, in hashing too; inside label and source a field is a value or absent, never null. Operational fields (erasure_key, expires_at, keep, added_at) are not hashed, nor is a field this format does not know, so a scorer reads only the hashed fields.

input.description: Any JSON value; an object is usual. Hashed into the inputs hash.

expected.description: The label: any JSON value, or absent. Hashed into the labels hash.

label.description: Who made the label. Hashed into the labels hash.

kind.description: human, ai, adjudicated (two raters disagreed and a third settled it), disputed (raters disagreed and nobody settled it: scored apart, slice 2).

by.description: A person's id, or for an AI label the judge's name.

model.description: For an AI label, the model.

judge_version.description: For an AI label, the judge's version (its author's number with its execution identity, additions/design.md 2.9).

raters.description: For an adjudicated or disputed label, the raters who disagreed.

split.description: A split set by hand; it wins over the dataset's rule.

cluster.description: Samples sharing a key (one customer, one document) stay on one side of a split and are resampled together.

source.description: Where the sample came from. production_run samples need expires_at or keep.

metadata.description: Free-form host fields a scorer may read. Hashed into the metadata hash.

erasure_key.description: The host's key for finding every sample about one person, for erasure. Not hashed.
